extracted.name: Strawberry Chicken Salad
extracted.description: This delightful strawberry chicken salad combines strawberries, chicken, and pecans with homemade poppy seed dressing for a zingy sandwich filling.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Mix mayonnaise, lemon juice, honey, and poppy seeds together in a medium bowl.
Add chicken, strawberries, pecans, celery, green onions, parsley; toss to combine. Season with salt and pepper.
